title: Cosmic Boy and Floating Head
description: A surreal scene depicts a large glowing bald head with wide eyes and an open mouth floating in a starry night sky above a green hillside. In the foreground, a boy in black and gold futuristic armor stands on the grass, firing a bright yellow energy beam from his outstretched hand toward colorful floating rings, balls, and small cartoonish creatures, while a purple window in the upper right shows stained-glass panels with frightened faces and melting drips.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene at night with a giant bald head with wide eyes and open mouth floating in a starry sky connected by glowing lines, a boy in black and gold futuristic armor standing on a green grassy hill firing a powerful yellow energy blast from his hand, colorful rings and balls floating around including pink purple and blue ones, small cartoon creatures on the grass and in the air, a purple framed window in the sky showing four stained glass panels with scared faces and melting drips, bright energy explosion and sparks, dramatic lighting
